items.caption: This bronze-script form of 日, attributed to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋 (集成4316), has a rounded enclosure and a central mark. Paleographic evidence interprets 日 as a depiction of the sun; the image is a modern vector redraw, not the vessel itself.
items.alt: A thick oval outline surrounds a small central oval mark.
items.selection_reason: Provides a visually clear, sourced bronze-script example relevant to the sun-pictogram interpretation. Its attributed period and source are documented, while the image itself is a modern redraw.

limitations.text: This attributed example does not establish when the rounded outline or central mark developed, or a detailed sequence of graphic changes.
